review.imagery: Twenty-six current official project renders were selected after visual review of all 28 published gallery/banner files and the complete 78-page broker-hosted brochure index. Two duplicate aerial/bedroom views are excluded. The full street building supplies the hero and listing card. Home interiors, gardens, pools, padel, workspaces and wellness rooms retain factual scene labels. The brochure contains work-in-progress gym/stair notes, so current primary renders provide the selected imagery. Final delivery and medical outcomes are not asserted.
review.floorPlans: Five complete home sheets show nine A-type layouts, comprising four studios, four 1 BR homes and one 2 BR home with a maid room. Fifteen complete overview sheets show the ground floor, floors 1–13 and roof. Floorplates also identify A/B variants. Separate detailed B-type drawings and whole-home area totals are absent. Printed room and balcony dimensions remain visible. Confirm the selected unit, contractual area and configuration with Imtiaz. All twenty complete drawing sheets on physical pages 2–21 were visually reviewed. Each of the thirteen numbered residential floors remains individually selectable. Ground and roof amenity legends, nine home layouts, key plans, orientation, elevation diagrams, dimensions and source notices are intact. Category starting sizes are not assigned to individual drawings. Areas are not calculated from room dimensions.
review.location: The complete branded page 76 map and all twelve printed estimates were visually reviewed. Five twenty-minute entries remain distinct from the map’s broad fifteen-minute heading. The primary’s named KORE embed is recorded with HTML hash. Its camera-centre parameters are not converted into a project/entrance coordinate. The original plan cover supplies the DLRC/Wadi Al Safa 5 identification.
review.provenance: Current official HTML/gallery files and complete branded brochure/floor-plan PDFs have source receipts and SHA256 checks. Both PDF files are hosted by Mitchell’s and remain labeled broker mirrors. Complete source pages, original bytes and physical page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific whole-home areas, separate detailed B-type layouts, contractual numbered-unit matching, reliable visitor entrance coordinates, dated construction photographs and final unit views/finishes were not established.
